integrity: Exact enumeration of every nonzero coefficient triple; independent exact algebraic smoothness on every coordinate-orbit representative; independent finite-field zeta p-rank checks. Self-review only; no independent external audit.
limitations: All counts concern embedded bidegree-(2,4) divisors on the split quadric over F2 modulo ruling-preserving PGL2(F2)^2, not abstract curve classes or other fields. The six-point bound and p-rank formula are prior theory; a published or unindexed equivalent embedded census remains possible.
title: Rational-point and Jacobian \(2\)-rank strata of genus-three \((2,4)\) curves over \(\mathbf F_2\)
